description: Output captured from the code Secria's apps and servers run, unmodified apart from import paths. Keys, seeds, message keys and pre-shared keys are fixed test inputs; salts, nonces and encapsulations are what the code drew. password_derivation, password_derivation_v1, vaults, messages, recovery and archived_key_sets come from the web and mobile apps' crypto module (argon2-browser 1.18.0, mlkem 2.3.0); each vault gives the vault key the app wrote it under. vpn_boxes come from the VPN API's pre-shared-key sealer, and protected_mail from the web app's password-protected mail.

messages.name: message from the app to a recipient, with the sender copy

vpn_boxes.name: version 1 box sealed by the deployed VPN API
